chapter.verse: Pasian aw, keimah hong honkhia nuam in! Topa aw, keimah huh dingin hong manlang in!
Kei, thah hong sawmte maizumin kibuaigawpsak in! Keima siat nading a deihte nungkiksak in la, mindaisak in!
“Ha, ha!” a cite, a maizumna uh tawh maikhingsak in!
Nangmah hong zongte khempeuh lungdamin nangma sungah kipak ta hen! Na hotkhiatna a deihte in, “Pasian in lian hi!” ci ci ta hen.
Ahih hangin keimah zawng-in ka cimawh hi, Pasian aw, hong manlang in! Nangmah in keimah huhpa leh hong honkhiatpa na hi hi; Topa aw, hong zekai kei in!
